name: memstruct
description: A memory standard for all: one record format and one merge contract so memory systems interoperate. Zero-dependency CLI - lint, merge (LWW + tombstones), audit-merge.

scripts.test: node test/version-truth.mjs && node test/run.mjs && node --test test/status.test.mjs test/release-verify.test.cjs test/check-action-pins.test.cjs test/ship-from-download.test.cjs
scripts.lint:docs: node scripts/check-docs-frontmatter.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-links.cjs && node scripts/check-docs-style.cjs && node scripts/check-fiction-signatures.cjs && node scripts/check-jekyll-filters.cjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint:language && npm run lint:pins && npm run lint:spec && npm run lint:docs && npm run conform && npm run sync:check && node bin/cli.mjs check
